Lessons.Title: The Ellipse
ExplanationParagraphs: Ellipse is locus with constant sum of distances to two foci.
For horizontal major axis centered(h,k), (x−h)²/a²+(y−k)²/b²=1 with a≥b>0.
Focal c²=a²−b², vertices h±a and foci h±c.
Complete squares to convert general form and identify center.
Whispering chamber and arch applications model half-ellipses.
Independent Cool-down: identify the standard conic, state relevant foci/axis features, and verify the equation with an independent point.
